description: This file defines mechanisms for processing and logging distributed elastic events within the PyTorch distributed framework. It includes functions for creating loggers, recording events, and constructing rendezvous events, with related API imports and handling of event objects.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a distributed event with associated metadata.

classes.name: EventMetadataValue
classes.description: Represents metadata details for an event.

classes.name: EventSource
classes.description: Enumerates possible sources of an event, e.g., WORKER.

classes.name: NodeState
classes.description: Enumerates states of a node, e.g., INIT, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED.

classes.name: RdzvEvent
classes.description: Represents a rendezvous related event with relevant attributes.

methods.name: logging.Logger _get_or_create_logger(destination: str = "null")
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a logger for a specified destination, configuring handlers and levels.

methods.name: None record(event: Event, destination: str = "null")
methods.description: Logs an Event object to a specified destination.

methods.name: None record_rdzv_event(event: RdzvEvent)
methods.description: Logs an RdzvEvent object to the 'dynamic_rendezvous' logger.

methods.name: None construct_and_record_rdzv_event( run_id: str, message: str, node_state: NodeState, name: str = "", hostname: str = "", pid: int | None = None, master_endpoint: str = "", local_id: int | None = None, rank: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructs an RdzvEvent with provided parameters and records it.

ctags.signature: ( run_id: str, message: str, node_state: NodeState, name: str = "", hostname: str = "", pid: int | None = None, master_endpoint: str = "", local_id: int | None = None, rank: int | None = None, )
